title: "RMW implementation not installed (expected identifier of 'rmw_cyclonedds_cpp')" in ROS 2: missing packages, typos, unsourced Zenoh libraries and the colcon CMake error, measured
excerpt: What the RMW_IMPLEMENTATION load error means and how to read its dlopen part: a missing package, a typo, a dependency like libzenohc.so not yet on the path, and the colcon build form. Install times, daemon and mixed-RMW behavior measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
